equation_summary: Rodimus has no fla/ops/rodimus directory; the mixer is a GLA call from the layer (fla/layers/rodimus.py:188-210): k is L2-normalized then multiplied by an external input gate it_gate = softplus(g_gate)^sigmoid(tau_gate) (rodimus.py:173-184); the URM-relevant call is chunk_gla/fused_recurrent_gla(q,k,v, gk=rt_gate_log, state_v_first=True) with rt_gate_log = -softplus(g_gate)*sigmoid(tau_gate), a per-CHANNEL log decay on the K axis, mem_size=64 keys, and default scale = mem_size^-0.5 applied to q inside the op (fla/ops/gla/fused_recurrent.py:116-117). The state equation is GLA's additive law: S_t = Diag(exp(gk_t)) S_{t-1} + k_t v_t^T, read after update, with the source-defined 1/sqrt(64) read scale and a value-first physical layout flag. External: short conv, low-rank input gate i_gate_proj on v, residual_weight add, RMSNormGated output (rodimus.py:102-127,227-231).
